items.n_81783e9c71: Update: UDP has a new protocol; on a server that has not updated to it yet, the app connects without UDP
items.n_a7817ffd46: Improve: The Android app starts two to four times faster, most of all on budget phones
items.n_5b279e3c1d: Improve: The app draws its screens itself rather than as a web page, and text is easier to read, with more contrast
items.n_0cb406f0c8: Improve: The app no longer needs Android System WebView
items.n_55ad4e9500: Feature: Always On comes to Windows and Linux: switch it on in Settings, or with the `always-on on` command on a computer with no desktop, and the VPN connects as the computer starts, before anyone signs in. While the server is out of reach it tries again, waiting longer each time. It stops when you disconnect, when another VPN app takes over, or when the server refuses the connection, and the app says why. On VpnHood! CONNECT it needs premium
items.n_f0a00c35c1: Update: On Windows the VPN runs as a service: it starts with Windows, the connection no longer depends on the window, and the window and its tray no longer ask for administrator rights. The first time you open this version, your settings, profiles, split lists and sign-in move into the service, and your device keeps its identity
items.n_ad3281cd04: Update: On Windows and Linux only an administrator can use the app; on a standard account its window says so
items.n_9a19856801: Update: On Windows and Linux, one VPN app made with VpnHood is connected at a time: connecting another - VpnHood! CLIENT and VpnHood! CONNECT, say - disconnects the first, which says another VPN app took over and stays off, even with Always On, until you connect it again
items.n_c0df31e475: Feature: On Windows and Linux, the app from our website updates itself: it downloads each new version in the background and installs it while the VPN is disconnected; Settings > Automatic Updates turns this off. With Always On, the app tells you after a few days, and its Install updates it at once; on a computer with no desktop, the `update` command does the same
items.n_121e382a6a: Feature: The Android app from our website updates itself: "Update now" downloads the version made for your phone's processor, with its progress, and the download goes on while the app is closed; then "Install". Android asks once to let the app install apps. An app installed from a store keeps updating there
items.n_b0b39c06b8: Feature: On Linux desktops that show tray icons (KDE, or GNOME with the AppIndicator extension), the app sits in the tray: it shows the connection, connects and disconnects, and closing the window keeps the app there. The tray icon is the app's own, with the connection's state on its corner
items.n_5dc140b763: Feature: On Linux the app has an uninstaller: Uninstall on its menu entry's right-click menu, or `sudo /opt/VpnHoodClient/vhuninstall` (`/opt/VpnHoodConnect/vhuninstall` for CONNECT). Settings and profiles stay for a later install unless you add `-purge`
items.n_a7cfb38768: Feature: In the EEA, the UK and Switzerland, the app asks in Google's own form before its ads use your data, and Settings > Privacy > Ad privacy choices changes your answer
items.n_e50a33a1dd: Feature: In the EEA, the UK and Switzerland, usage data stays off until you agree: the first-run page asks once, with a box you tick yourself, on Google Play and after this update too
items.n_d794d9a355: Update: The Android app from our website no longer contains AppsFlyer, so it no longer reports which link it was installed from
items.n_5b69ce0b02: Update: The app's name on iOS is written as on its other platforms, VpnHood! CONNECT
items.n_4480a88410: Update: On a plan with a speed limit, the first megabytes after a pause go at full speed, so pages load quickly, and only steady heavy use is held to the limit
items.n_77a5107c3d: Improve: Buying on the website opens the checkout in the app's language
items.n_9b9559baaf: Fix: Split Local Network does what it says: on, local devices such as a printer or a TV are reached directly; off, their traffic stays in the VPN. It did the opposite while Allow Split Tunneling was off, or on a server that carries local addresses
items.n_bb11aaba36: Fix: With "Share anonymous usage data" off, the app no longer reports each start, nor the VPN each connection and its usage, and turning it off while connected stops the VPN's reports at once
items.n_18fac5b14f: Fix: Where the app asks you to accept its terms at first run, it sends no usage data before you accept them
items.n_5b95a05f37: Fix: A VPN started without opening the app - always-on, the quick-settings tile, the phone's VPN settings, or the system restarting it - follows your latest settings, "Share anonymous usage data" among them, and the server and location you chose, never a server you removed
items.n_fa2e4b43a7: Fix: Where Google Play works only through the VPN, the app's update now comes once you connect
items.n_1a7bdc2a0d: Fix: "Check for update" always answers - you have the latest version, or it could not check - and shows the update's notice even after you chose Later
items.n_61b763aea0: Fix: On Android 13 and older, the app connects to a server whose certificate is one of Let's Encrypt's new ones; its certificate check refused it
items.n_38412680ab: Fix: On Android 7.0 to 8.1, the app no longer closes at once every time it starts, and on 7.0 it can check for updates, and the app from our website can download them
items.n_159b31827d: Fix: On Android, the app no longer closes when you connect or disconnect just as a connection is ending, when you connect again right after a disconnect or a failed connect, or, on Android 12 and older, when Android's quick settings restart just as they show the app's tile
items.n_2628688596: Fix: On Android, going back after an access key's link opened the app over itself no longer leaves the app unable to ask for the VPN permission ("Please open the app and grant VPN permission"), to sign in, to buy or to show ads
items.n_6778d67bff: Fix: On some phones, the quick-settings tile and the app no longer stall as they start, where Android could say the app isn't responding
items.n_2690cb033c: Improve: The Quick Settings tile no longer starts Firebase in its own process, so it appears faster on low-end devices
items.n_562895b16a: Fix: On Android, a server added from a link or a key file shows on the home page at once and stays selected, and its message no longer says "updated" for a new one; a link that opens the app before you have accepted its terms adds its server once you accept
items.n_cd2707a00e: Fix: When the app was updated while connected, it now opens on Disconnected instead of saying "VPN service encountered an issue"
items.n_9f00a80fd6: Fix: When the app was updated or force stopped while connected, or the phone restarted, it now opens on Disconnected instead of saying "VPN service encountered an issue"
items.n_2faafb23a9: Fix: On Android, Cancel on the system's VPN connection request now stops connecting, instead of showing the request again
items.n_f0416921ee: Fix: On Android, the VPN connects when your split by IP addresses on the device leaves out a range that ends just before 127.0.0.0, such as 126.0.0.0/8; it failed with "Bad address"
items.n_42884457e6: Fix: Your settings and servers now go into your phone's backup and come back on a new phone - the backup used to be too big for Google's limit - while your sign-in, the app's logs and its unpacked files stay on the phone they belong to
items.n_f55957fcdf: Fix: Your settings and servers now go into your phone's backup and come back on a new phone, while your sign-in, the app's logs and its unpacked files stay on the phone they belong to
items.n_6231e7f027: Fix: On a slow connection, an ad you chose to watch - Watch Ad, Free Server by Ad, or more minutes for your session - is no longer cut off while it is still loading
items.n_85af848c27: Fix: "Forgot password" on the sign-in form opens the account website's password reset page; it opened the site's home page
items.n_b906ffa9c4: Fix: After you delete your account, a device still signed in to it signs out, rather than quietly signing in again and making you a new account
items.n_3442540509: Fix: The Connect APK from GitHub now applies the app's remote settings, as every other Connect build does
items.n_3943f18063: Fix: A big upload over a slow connection no longer holds up the device's other traffic, such as browsing
items.n_74655c0e16: Fix: A connection whose VPN adapter stops on its own, or is disabled under it, now ends with an error, instead of staying connected in name while the device's traffic goes around the VPN; on Windows, disconnecting or the reconnect after a network change could rarely crash while traffic was flowing
items.n_3df80e8c17: Fix: On Linux without systemd-resolved, the VPN never set its DNS servers, so DNS went around the VPN, and its DNS server stayed in resolv.conf after disconnecting; resolvconf now sets and removes them, and where it cannot - NetworkManager without systemd-resolved, as Arch-based systems have by default - connecting stops with an error that says what to turn on
items.n_3c79b4560b: Fix: On Linux, signing in and buying from the app's window work, and the checkout opens in your own browser
items.n_39a95b95e3: Fix: On Linux desktops such as Lubuntu, connecting and disconnecting no longer pop up network notices, one of them saying your Ethernet connection was lost
items.n_76fa760dcc: Fix: On Linux, the installer sets up MsQuic, for the QUIC channel - it never found MsQuic's installer, and the app used TCP - on more distributions too: openSUSE, Arch-based ones such as EndeavourOS and Manjaro, and those built on Ubuntu, Debian or RHEL, such as Linux Mint, Pop!_OS, Rocky Linux and AlmaLinux. It installs ICU where it is missing, as on Debian 13's cloud image, where the app did not start
items.n_2f4839afc1: Fix: On Linux, the app's installed files belong to root; they kept the user id of the machine that built them, so an account with that id could replace what the VPN service runs as root
items.n_369fbee124: Fix: On Linux, the install command in the Linux guide works (sudo su -c "bash <(…)"; the installer prints it when run without root); installing or updating removes the downloaded package, an update keeps only the three newest versions and no longer leaves the VPN service stopped when its package does not unpack, and a no to starting at boot no longer turns off updates
items.n_240800cf92: Fix: Online games that send large packets, such as Counter-Strike 2 and Dota 2 on Steam, work through the VPN; every packet over 1280 bytes was dropped. A VpnHoodServer of your own needs this release too
